newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-CRONJE WINS TOSS, S.AFRICA BAT AGAINST INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CRONJE WINS TOSS, S.AFRICA BAT AGAINST INDIA.

text.p: South African cricket captain Hansie Cronje won the toss and chose to bat on the opening day of the second test against India in Cape Town on Thursday. South Africa lead the three test series 1-0.

South Africa - Andrew Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Adam Bacher, Daryll Cullinan, Hansie Cronje (captain), Brian McMillan, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson (wicketkeeper), Lance Klusener, Allan Donald, Paul Adams.

India - Woorkeri Raman, Nayan Mongia (wicketkeeper), Rahul Dravid, Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Mohammed Azharuddin, VVS Laxman, Anil Kumble, Javagal Srinath, Venkatesh Prasad, Doda Ganesh.
